summary: Genprex filed an 8-K to announce a press release regarding its research collaborator's abstract published at the 2026 ASCO Annual Meeting. The abstract presents positive clinical data on predictive biomarkers (Trop-2 and PTEN) in patients receiving its lead drug candidate, Reqorsa Gene Therapy, for lung cancer. The filing is a routine current report on other events, not a special situation. No corporate transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or capital return is involved. The document solely discusses clinical trial results and biomarker correlations.
